bundle.shortDescription: Visual manager for EchoVault memories and AI agent session logs
bundle.longDescription: Echo Studio is a portable Windows desktop app that lets you browse, search, edit, archive, and delete EchoVault memories, and explore session logs from your AI coding agent CLI in a chat-style viewer.
